primary_coordinate.derivation: SHA256 fingerprint mapping, a deterministic pseudorandom sky direction not a physical sky localization

precommitted_method.canonical: Sort 3772 strings RA with 12 decimal places, Dec with 12 decimal places, operator, comma-separated and newline terminated. SHA256(domain UTF8 + canonical UTF8). Decode first 8 bytes big-endian to uniform RA and next 8 to equal-area Dec via inverse sine.

geometric_diagnostic.interpretation: Mirror transformation symmetry creates an equatorial meridian bias; not a physical or statistically meaningful collapse.

scientific_firewall.required_evidence: Independent repeatable observations, cross-instrument source counterpart, matched sky controls, time and provenance

next: Verify exact Gaia DR3 and AllWISE crossmatch from repaired JANUS-COSMOS workflow; do not infer novel astrophysical discovery without real independent repeated observations.
